name: nuphy-codex
description: Show Codex status on a stock NuPhy Air65 V3 over macOS wired USB

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex task status on a NuPhy Air65 V3
interface.longDescription: Display aggregate Codex task status on stock Air65 V3 firmware over macOS wired USB. Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz, other NuPhy models, Claude Code, custom firmware, and automatic terminal failure signals are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Codex status lights for NuPhy Air65 V3
